Every ticket type

No Ticket Details export was included in this run, so the ticket data isn't available.

Source: Megatix › Reports › Completed Orders Detail for the five 2027 XXL events, exported each morning. Sold = paid web tickets, VIP upgrades included, matching the Megatix Total Sales (For Period) chart (Lauren 22/10): resales, $0 / 100%-discount orders and the free ticket in bundle deals (Buy 1 Get 1 Free, 2x/3x deals) are left out; comps = complimentary + consignment + those free bundle tickets. Days run on Perth time, the same as the Megatix Total Sales chart.
Channels follow the rows in the DAILY SALES sheets (Promoters, Emails & Texts, Socials, Local DJs, Affiliates, TikTok/YouTube, Ads, Untracked), except that Website direct (the WEBSITE link plus the BACKSTAGE10 pop-up code) is shown on its own rather than inside Ads and Emails & Texts, and Call centre (the FRIEND codes) and Birthdays (the BIRTHDAY and BDAY codes) are shown on their own rather than inside Socials, and Google (the GOOGLE ads link) is shown on its own rather than inside Ads (Lauren 27/10). VIP upgrades are listed per city under Where sales came from, outside that table's total; since 22/10 they are included in Tickets sold (Lauren). FRIEND sales count as Call centre on every show (Adelaide included). A VIP upgrade bought with a FRIEND code is shown on the Call centre line (so FRIEND counts match Megatix's code reports) but is still not counted as a ticket sold or in the total (Lauren 20/10).
